venue.name: Danone Research & Innovation, Daniel Carasso Center

access.label: By car
access.text: Mandatory drop-off point at Pass. des Charmes, 91190 Gif-sur-Yvette, where a hostess will welcome you. No parking or drop-off in front of the building. Make sure your driver picks you up at this same location for your return.

access.label: Public transport
access.text: The site is not served by public transportation.

access.label: On-site parking
access.text: By prior reservation only, via the logistics form sent by email.

day2.title: Top-to-Top Day
day2.description: For invited partners with scheduled T2T meetings at Danone Headquarters (Lafayette, Paris). Confirm your attendance and add it to your calendar.
day2.visibilityRule: Show only to invitees with hasDay2 = true

access.label: By car
access.text: Recommended drop-off point at 19 rue Cadet, 75009 Paris. No parking on site.

access.label: By metro
access.text: Cadet station, 80 m walk from the Lafayette site.

accommodation.intro: Book your room as soon as possible: preferential rates are available at some nearby hotels.
